assessment: This fundamental work has the potential to advance our understanding of brain activity using electrophysiological data, by proposing a completely new approach to reconstructing EEG data that challenges the assumptions typically made in the solutions to Maxwell’s equations. Convincing evidence for the superior spatio-temporal resolution of this method is provided through a number of experiments, including simultaneous FMRI/EEG acquisitions. This work will be of broad interest to neuroscientists and neuroimaging.
